description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011 Order under Section 3
categorisation: This gazette notification contains an order amending the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It involves the modification of regulations (specifically exemptions to the levy) through statutory instruments, making it primarily about legal framework and regulatory changes rather than government personnel or structure.
